name: selby_blue
note: Selby's blue in the last frame of the 2014 World Championship final, read off the broadcast by eye: the blue on its spot, the cue ball 0.61 m to its left (seen from baulk) and 0.05 m towards the black, so the pot to the right middle pocket is almost straight. Top and left-hand side at a firm pace; the aim is the centre-ball line and the test turns it until the blue drops. C8.
